en.headline: 12 own commits, 23 automated, one issue comment and one discussion started
en.summary: On 2026-10-18 sogeisetsu made **12 own commits** across three repositories, plus 23 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. Seven commits in `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list/inspect/disable/enable acceptance checks, revised the spec, and moved plans into `.openchamber/plans`. Four commits in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` fixed duplicate resident-issue creation, notifier failure fallback, the verify invariant for additive phrasing, and reworked AI failure visibility and the 30-day summary. One commit in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` added an `opencode-provider` knowledge category on catalog sources, credentials and endpoints. Issue activity covered 1 issue (opened or closed 1): the user commented on `openchamber/openchamber` #4939 about the render-page selection menu, which had 2 comments. The user also started discussion #5114 in `openchamber/openchamber` to split that fix into a frame-to-host selection bridge first. Two replies arrived on `openchamber/openchamber` issues #4601 and #4899, and btriapitsyn closed #4896, #4920 and #4601. No pull requests, reviews or releases were recorded.

zh.headline: 本人提交 12 次、自动提交 23 次，评论 1 个 issue 并新开 1 个讨论
zh.summary: 2026-10-18，sogeisetsu 在三个仓库完成 **12 次本人提交**，另有 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 23 次自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 7 次提交实现了 `skill_management` 插件及 list/inspect/disable/enable 验收，修订了规范，并把计划迁到 `.openchamber/plans`。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 4 次提交修复了常住 issue 重复创建、notifier 失败时的降级处理、自动提交「相加表述」不变式的扫描范围，并改版了 AI 失败可见性与 30 天总结。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 1 次提交新增 `opencode-provider` 知识类别，涉及 catalog 来源、凭据与端点。issue 方面共 1 个（新开或关闭 1 个）：在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 #4939（渲染页选中文本无法打开评论菜单）下留言，该 issue 共 2 条评论。当天还新开了 `openchamber/openchamber` 的讨论 #5114，建议先把该修复拆成 frame→host 选区桥接。收到 `openchamber/openchamber` issue #4601 和 #4899 的两条回复，btriapitsyn 关闭了 #4896、#4920 和 #4601。当天没有 PR、评审或发布。
